functionDescriptions: Required, with CNTNAP2, for radial and longitudinal organization of myelinated axons. Plays a role in the formation of functional distinct domains critical for saltatory conduction of nerve impulses in myelinated nerve fibers. Demarcates the paranodal region of the axo-glial junction. In association with contactin involved in the signaling between axons and myelinating glial cells. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:24319099, ECO:0000269|PubMed:27818385, ECO:0000269|PubMed:28374019}.
